p: god to Pharaoh: I have given you power and authority to speak in my name and to execute my judgments on him.
judgments: To strengthen Moses' faith, God promises again to punish most severely the oppression of his Church.
fourscore years old: Moses lived in affliction and banishment forty years before he commanded his office to deliver God's people.
sorcerers: It seems that these were Jannes and Jambres; 2Ti 3:8 so the wicked maliciously resist the truth of God.
the river's brink against he come: That is, the Nile river.
fish that was in the river: To show that it was a true miracle, God plagued them in that which was most needed for the preservation of life.
so with their enchantments: In outward appearance, after the seven days were ended.
